{{Top|leg}}
'''Demolition satchels''' were bags used by the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force|Chiss Commandos]] during the [[Swarm War]] to hold their [[vape charge]]s while they were on the battlefield. The commandos were equipped with these at the [[Battle of Snevu]] to carry the vape charges they used to destroy the [[parasite bomb]].

==Appearances==
*''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''
